title: PCB read
observations: 1 PCB document, 289 layer entries (2 copper), 17 nets and 33 placed components were read from the fixture.
Layer records carry id/name/type/color/transparency/locked; the copper layer count comes from a dedicated API.
Coordinate units and anchor semantics were not independently measured in this run (the API exposes convertCanvasOriginToDataOrigin/convertDataOriginToCanvasOrigin but we did not probe them).
risks: unit / y-axis convention needs an explicit conversion step and a unit test
primitive ids are session-scoped; re-read before any write
outline / copper geometry were not dumped (only counts and layers), so a geometry-complete read is unproven
